name.text: Calculating the Volume of a Triangular-Based Pyramid

questiontext.text:
The figure below shows a pyramid with a triangular base. The base of the triangle measures \({@b@}\,\text{m}\), the height of the triangle is \({@h_tri@}\,\text{m}\), and the vertical height of the pyramid is \({@H@}\,\text{m}\). Find the volume of the pyramid.

[[jsxgraph height='400px' width='500px']] var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(divid, { boundingbox: [-2.5, 8.5, 10.5, -2.5], axis: false, showCopyright: false, keepaspectratio: true }); /* Triangular base */ var A = board.create('point', [0, 1], { name: '', visible: false }); var B = board.create('point', [7, 1], { name: '', visible: false }); var C = board.create('point', [2.5, -1], { name: '', visible: false }); /* Apex */ var D = board.create('point', [3.5, 7], { name: '', visible: false }); /* Base triangle */ board.create('polygon', [A, B, C], { fillOpacity: 0.15, borders: { strokeWidth: 2 }, vertices: { visible: false } }); /* Pyramid edges */ board.create('segment', [D, A], {strokeWidth: 2}); board.create('segment', [D, B], {strokeWidth: 2}); board.create('segment', [D, C], {strokeWidth: 2}); /* Base edges */ board.create('segment', [A, B], {strokeWidth: 2}); board.create('segment', [B, C], {strokeWidth: 2}); /* Hidden base edge */ board.create('segment', [A, C], { strokeWidth: 2, dash: 2 }); /* Base length */ board.create('text', [3.2, 1.35, '{#b#} m'], { fontSize: 16 }); /* Foot of triangle height on AB */ var E = board.create('point', [2.5, 1], { name: '', visible: false }); /* Triangle height */ board.create('segment', [C, E], { strokeWidth: 2, dash: 2 }); board.create('text', [2.7, -0.05, '{#h_tri#} m'], { fontSize: 16 }); /* Foot of vertical pyramid height */ var F = board.create('point', [3.5, 1], { name: '', visible: false }); /* Vertical height */ board.create('segment', [D, F], { strokeWidth: 2, dash: 2 }); board.create('text', [3.8, 4.0, '{#H#} m'], { fontSize: 16 }); board.unsuspendUpdate(); [[/jsxgraph]]

\(\text{Volume}=\)[[input:ans1]]\(\,\text{m}^3\)[[validation:ans1]][[feedback:prt1]]

generalfeedback.text:
Given:

Base of triangle, \(b = {@b@}\,\text{m}\)
Height of triangle, \(h = {@h_tri@}\,\text{m}\)
Vertical height of pyramid, \(H = {@H@}\,\text{m}\)

  1. Compute the area of the triangular base:

    \( \begin{align} \text{Base area} &= \frac{1}{2} \times \text{base} \times \text{height of triangle} \\ &= \frac{1}{2} \times {@b@} \times {@h_tri@} \\ &= {@Base_area@}\,\text{m}^2 \end{align} \)

  2. Compute the volume of the pyramid using \(V = \frac{1}{3} \times \text{Base area} \times \text{vertical height}\):

    \( \begin{align} V &= \frac{1}{3} \times {@Base_area@} \times {@H@} \\ &= {@V@}\,\text{m}^3 \end{align} \)

Therefore,
The volume of the pyramid is \( {@Volume_pyramid@}\,\text{m}^3\)

truefeedback.text:
You have calculated the area of the triangular base, but you have not used the vertical height of the pyramid.

The area of the triangular base is

\(B=\frac{1}{2}b h_{\text{tri}}={@Base_area@}\,\text{cm}^2.\)

To calculate the volume of a pyramid, you need to use the base area together with the vertical height \(H\):

\(V=\frac{1}{3}BH.\)

Your answer \({@Volume_mistake2@}\,\text{cm}^3\) is the area of the triangular base, not the volume of the pyramid.

Try again by using the vertical height of the pyramid in the volume calculation.
